## v0.5.10 · Exact Memory Writes and Bounded Automatic Review

- [#256](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/256): prefer a unique exact Runtime entry for replace/remove before substring matching. Short entries such as `X` can be changed alongside `EGO_LINUX_CHROME`.
- [#234](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/234): create the original OpenViking content, verify indexing and exact readback, and return scoped file receipts for archive compensation. Original contributor commits remain in the merged history.
- [#257](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/257): add an independent automatic-review switch, cadence and attempt limits, bounded default spawn context, and committed-write receipts after failure. Pause automatic review before child creation with the incompatible Agent Teams composition.

### Packages and upgrade

New publications: **dsh-mnemon 0.5.10**, **OpenViking Provider 0.5.5**, **Memory Spaces Source 0.5.8**, and **Runtime Source 0.5.7**. The remaining thirteen plugins keep their existing versions.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.10
```

Restart DSH and reload the browser; use `headless` for that Profile. The review budget resets when the parent Agent unloads or the Host restarts. The Agent Teams guard pauses automatic review; upstream Team policy and manual delegation are not repaired.

### 中文说明

本版修复 Runtime 短条目编辑与删除、OpenViking 原文写入和回执验证，并限制自动审阅的频率、次数和默认上下文。自动审阅增加独立开关；遇到不兼容的 Agent Teams 组合时，在创建子 Agent 前暂停。审阅失败后保留已提交写入的回执，方便核对。

主包发布 0.5.10，OpenViking Provider 发布 0.5.5，Memory Spaces Source 发布 0.5.8，Runtime Source 发布 0.5.7。升级后重启 DSH。审阅预算随父 Agent 卸载或 Host 重启而重置；Team 兼容处理不代表上游策略或手动委派已修复。

The combined implementation passed 1,162 root tests plus plugin suites, real CLI/WebUI checks, real OpenViking storage checks and independent plugin composition. Before/after screenshots remain in the linked reports. Model responses and embeddings were deterministic local fixtures. The release workflow verifies versioned artifacts, Registry composition and a real upgrade before creating this Release.

See the [English release notes](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.10/docs/en/releases/v0.5.10.md) and [中文发布说明](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.10/docs/zh-CN/releases/v0.5.10.md).
